description:
The Weight Management Summit 2026, a free digital event presented by Food Navigator and organized by William Reed Group, is set to redefine the future of health and nutrition. Held across two sessions on November 5 and November 19, this summit is designed for professionals navigating the rapidly changing weight management market.

Participants will explore the metabolic health revolution, moving beyond GLP-1s to consider whole-body balance and new nutrition solutions. It will also examine how consumer trends are shifting towards weight-conscious eating that prioritizes taste and pleasure. Discussions will cover smarter ingredients, innovations that promote satiety, and new food formats such as portion-controlled meals.

The aim is to provide practical strategies and emerging scientific understanding to help meet evolving consumer expectations and foster innovation within the food and drink industry.

description:
Immerse yourself in the cutting edge of rheumatology as ACR Convergence 2026 unfolds in Orlando, Florida, from November 6–11.

This international gathering brings together individuals from various backgrounds, all focused on understanding the newest advancements and pivotal research shaping rheumatology. The program includes a range of sessions, from interactive formats like the Knowledge Bowl, Thieves Market, and Image Competition, to dedicated discussions such as the Patient Perspectives Program and the Global Rheumatology Summit. Participants will have opportunities to engage with new research through abstract presentations and hear directly from leading speakers.

Beyond the structured sessions, there will be ample time to connect with peers and colleagues. The event also provides the chance to earn Continuing Medical Education (CME) credits while exploring significant developments in the field. It serves as an important forum for fostering clinical and scientific excellence in rheumatology.

This gathering brings together scientists, clinicians, and researchers, offering a significant forum to delve into the latest scientific discoveries and educational content that shapes clinical practice.

Participants will explore the breadth of cardiovascular science, covering everything from fundamental research breakthroughs to clinical trials and their real-world applications. It's a chance to share insights, build connections, and collectively advance the field of cardiovascular health.

The Sessions play a role in developing new researchers and shaping global guidelines. This work ultimately helps transform how care is delivered and contributes to improving health and well-being for people everywhere.

This gathering brings together 290 artisans and producers from across France, presenting a wide selection of wines and gourmet foods.

Visitors can connect directly with these producers, learning about their craft and the stories behind their products. The offerings span exquisite regional wines, including organic choices, alongside artisanal chocolates, charcuterie, and cheeses. Products are available at direct producer prices. Geneva's Palexpo will host Les Automnales 2026 from November 6 to 15, inviting 140,000 visitors to a vibrant 10-day celebration. This annual public event offers a wide range of entertainment, culinary experiences, and shopping opportunities for those attending.

The Automnales Market features clearance sales and military surplus items. For food enthusiasts, the Automnales Food Festival includes the Cook’n’show culinary event and the Arvinis wine salon. Another section, Automnales Émotion, presents diverse activities such as an International Cat Exhibition, the RE&UP Genève initiative focused on sustainability, and the 10 km de Palexpo indoor race.

name: Royal Agricultural Winter Fair 2026
topics_keywords: Agricultur; Agricultural; Air; Al; Cultural; Fair
description:
Get ready for an unparalleled celebration of agriculture, local food, and equestrian excellence at the Royal Agricultural Winter Fair 2026. Each November, Toronto hosts this significant gathering, recognized as the world's largest indoor agriculture fair and international equestrian competition. It draws hundreds of thousands of people, from the general public to Canadian and international breeders and growers, who come to see champions recognized and experience a rich display of Canadian heritage.

A central part of the fair is the Royal Horse Show, recognized as North America's premier indoor equestrian event. Beyond this, visitors can find exciting agriculture competitions, delicious food and lifestyle exhibits, and engaging entertainment. The Royal Paddock offers unique shopping opportunities, and there are chances to learn from industry leaders. It's a place where friends and family can make lasting memories, offering something for every age group.

Mark your calendars for the AMIA Annual Symposium 2026, the leading event for professionals at the forefront of biomedical and health informatics. Here, significant research connects with practical applications, encouraging new approaches in clinical care, public health, and translational science.

Participants will have the opportunity to engage with leaders in the field, learn about key advancements in areas like AI, data science, and health IT, and discuss strategies for enhancing patient outcomes and healthcare delivery. This gathering serves as a crucial space for researchers, clinicians, educators, and policymakers to work together, exchange perspectives, and influence the direction of health information.

The symposium brings together individuals dedicated to using informatics to build a healthier world. It's a collective effort to advance progress within the continually evolving landscape of digital health.

From November 9-11, at the Hilton San Diego Bayfront in San Diego, CA, this gathering brings together senior manufacturing, technical operations, and quality executives—with over 68% holding Director-level positions or higher. Their discussions will focus on innovative strategies, emerging trends, and best practices within the field.

Those attending will hear from more than 27 thought leaders, including executives from companies like AstraZeneca, Eli Lilly, and Amgen. These experts will share their perspectives and experiences. As it marks its tenth anniversary, the summit will also recognize an individual with the Michael Kamarck Technical Operations Leadership Award. This award acknowledges a leader who has significantly contributed to the advancement of the biopharmaceutical industry.

The California Craft Beer Summit 2026, hosted by the California Craft Brewers Association, invites professionals to the Hyatt Regency Irvine from November 9-11, 2026. This three-day event brings together California's craft beer community, creating opportunities for learning and building relationships.

The program features over 20 expert-led sessions, providing extensive content on advocacy, education, and communication relevant to the industry. Attendees can explore more than 70 exhibitor booths, take part in off-flavored tastings, and attend various networking events to meet colleagues and industry leaders.

It offers a chance to learn about best practices, discover new developments, and appreciate the dedication within California's craft beer community.

description:
Elevate your investment strategy at the Canadian Investment Institute 2026, held from November 9-11 at The Royal at Atlantis Paradise Island, Nassau, Bahamas. This gathering is intended for experienced labour and management trustees, public sector trustees, and administrators who have worked in investment for at least three years. It provides a forum to hear from leading Canadian investment and economic professionals about navigating today's rapidly evolving economic landscape.

The Institute's discussions center on strategies for maximizing returns on plan assets, ensuring robust trustee oversight, and exploring avenues for a fund's future growth. Attendees will engage in a variety of investment sessions and interactive workshops. There will also be opportunities to connect with peers and discuss shared challenges and successes. For those looking to deepen their expertise, pre-conference Advanced Trust Management Standards (ATMS™) sessions are available. The aim is to offer insights into diverse fund approaches and their rationale, helping participants consider how to best position their own investments.

This two-day gathering is designed for public sector and enterprise executives who are navigating the complexities where digital identity meets national policy.

Participants will explore key subjects such as Identity-First Security, the changing landscape of AI and Non-Human Identity, and the future of Authentication with Passkeys. The program features 50 speakers across two tracks, also covering Policy, Privacy, Public Sector Identity, and approaches to Identity Resilience and Fraud Prevention.

The event offers a chance to hear diverse perspectives, discuss current challenges, and connect with 300 professionals working in this field in the nation's capital.

Navigate the complex and evolving landscape of industrial cybersecurity at the Industrial Security Conference Copenhagen 2026. topics_keywords: Congress; Energy; World
description:
Returning to the UK after 30 years, the ISWA World Congress 2026, hosted by CIWM in partnership with ISWA, will convene in the heart of London's Westminster. This significant gathering will bring together influential leaders and professionals from the global waste management community, all committed to advancing resource management and circular economy principles.

Recognizing the critical challenge of waste generation, which is projected to reach 3.8 billion tonnes by 2050, the Congress will highlight global best practices and encourage international collaboration. Participants will explore key themes including Human Rights, Political Commitment, Waste Planning, and the Economics of waste. These discussions are essential for accelerating the transition towards a circular economy.

The aim is to contribute to a future where waste is effectively managed, reused, and recycled, ultimately moving the world towards a more sustainable approach.

The 4th annual Space Economy Summit, presented by Economist Impact, will convene global leaders in Orlando, USA, on November 10th & 11th, 2026. This gathering, a key part of UCF Space Week, focuses on "Maximising returns to Earth: the infinite potential of space." It brings together representatives from space agencies, businesses, investors, and technology innovators.

The summit provides a forum for these diverse groups to discuss and work together. Discussions will cover essential subjects such as sustainable growth, manufacturing in space, building robust systems, funding approaches, and the changing financial landscape of lunar and cislunar operations. With more than 60 sessions and 100 speakers anticipated, participants can expect to deepen their understanding of how to balance the sector's expansion with responsible oversight, ultimately influencing the direction of the fast-growing space industry.

The day's agenda includes scenario-based debates and 'Loyalty X™' talks. The program will feature discussions covering human experience, participation, and ethical considerations in heritage work. Attendees can also explore a Serious Gaming for Heritage exhibition, which will present playable prototypes. The conference provides a forum for researchers, practitioners, and students to exchange knowledge. They will share perspectives on technologies like AI and AR/VR, discussing their use in documentation, interpretation, and community engagement, thereby contributing to the ongoing evolution of heritage practice.

Shaping the future of Australia's living sectors takes centre stage at the Living Sectors Summit 2026, held on 11-12 November at ICC Sydney. This gathering brings together leaders and key figures from across the institutional housing landscape – including investors, developers, operators, and government – to delve into important developments in Build-to-Rent, PBSA, retirement living, and social housing.

Participants can expect valuable perspectives from international speakers such as Legal & General's Dan Batterton and Moda Living's Johnny Caddick. For 2026, the program introduces site visits to leading Sydney developments, offering practical learning experiences. Significant time is set aside for networking, including a Leaders Dinner, allowing attendees to build important relationships and collaborate on strategies for capital, policy, technology, and ESG, aiming to drive the next decade of housing innovation.

The Skift Travel Commerce Summit 2026, a focused one-day event on November 11 in New York City, will dissect the profound shifts rewiring the travel industry. Held at Apella by Alexandria, the summit explores the key challenges and opportunities shaping the future of travel commerce.

The event brings together VP-level and above decision-makers from airlines, hotels, online travel agencies, and global distribution systems. Discussions, informed by Skift Research, will delve into topics such as the evolving booking journey, AI's influence on customer relationships, payment infrastructure, and the regulatory changes impacting distribution.

This limited-attendance event, with a strong focus on industry operators, offers insights into how discovery, distribution, payments, and loyalty are converging. It aims to provide leaders with a clearer understanding of the evolving commerce landscape, helping them navigate its complexities strategically.

description:
Public-sector leaders seeking to harness the power of cutting-edge innovation are invited to the GA Emerging Technology Summit 2026. This gathering will be held on November 12, 2026, at Atlanta's Courtland Grand Hotel, bringing together state, regional, and local government professionals.

Participants will explore the impact of AI, automation, edge computing, and data, understanding how these technologies can reshape public service. The program will feature hands-on demonstrations, insights into policy, and real-world case studies. The aim is to identify strategies for serving communities more efficiently, equitably, and effectively.

Registration is free for eligible public-sector participants, supporting efforts to advance innovation within government.

description:
Unlocking the next era of artificial intelligence, the Generative AI Summit Toronto 2026 convenes on November 12 in Toronto, Canada. This event is for engineers, developers, and senior leaders who are navigating the complexities of deploying Generative AI in real-world applications.

The program is structured across three stages: Headliners, Generative AI, and Agentic AI. Participants can expect to gain system-focused insights covering control, reliability, evaluation, and governance. Discussions will also explore practical architectures for moving AI agents from initial prototypes to full production, delve into advanced tooling, and address effective scaling strategies.

Over 30 expert speakers will share their knowledge, complemented by interactive workshops. This provides a setting to address production challenges, evaluate recent infrastructure advancements, and engage with the AI community in Toronto. The aim is to help attendees deepen their understanding and contribute to the ongoing development of AI.

Germany's premier gathering for nursing professionals, the German Nursing Day 2026, invites you to hub27 for an unparalleled exploration of the sector's future. This congress aims to provide current perspectives and facilitate networking among professionals.

The program will focus on "Digitale Pflege" (Digital Nursing), exploring innovations that are changing patient care and improving efficiency. A separate "Care Culture Congress" will discuss approaches for creating supportive and effective care settings. An online program will also be available, allowing participants to customize their experience.

The event offers an opportunity to connect with leaders in the field, learn about new practices, and contribute to the ongoing development of nursing in Germany.

Prepare for the Middle East's most powerful AI event as the Global AI Show 2026 descends upon Abu Dhabi's Space42 Arena from November 18-19. This two-day summit is for over 6,000 enterprise leaders, founders, investors, and government representatives who are focused on implementing AI solutions at scale.

Participants will explore the full spectrum of AI, from advanced infrastructure and generative systems to critical discussions on ethical AI, cybersecurity, and energy applications. The event will feature insights from over 150 expert speakers and demonstrations from more than 100 exhibitors.

description:
Navigating the profound shifts in consumer behavior, particularly those driven by GLP-1 medications, is paramount for senior retail, brand, data, and commerce leaders. The GLP-1 Shopper Summit 2026, a focused gathering, will take place on November 12, 2026, at The Hilton Chicago. This event offers a dedicated space to explore "How Changing Appetites Are Reshaping the Basket, the Store and Brand Growth."

Discussions will delve into evolving shopper behaviors, category transformations, and innovative merchandising approaches for the wellness consumer. The summit aims to provide insights that extend beyond readily available research, fostering meaningful connections and the development of practical ideas for product assortment, innovation, and growth planning within a dynamic market.

Elevate your expertise and connect with the forefront of optical innovation at the Scottish Optical Conference 2026, held on Saturday 14th and Sunday 15th November at the Radisson Blu Hotel, Glasgow. The event aims to provide valuable insights and foster professional development within the optical sector.

The ultimate winter sports celebration returns as Snowbound Expo 2026 ignites the season on November 14-15 at Mohegan Sun in Uncasville, Connecticut. This event marks the unofficial start of the 2026/27 snow sports season, bringing together skiers, riders, and outdoor enthusiasts from across New England.

Attendees can explore the newest gear, technology, and apparel. The Inspiration Stage will feature talks from notable figures such as Travis Rice, Jessie Diggins, and Kimmy Fasani. name: Stromlo Running Festival 2026
topics_keywords: Al; Fest; Festival; Running
description:
Lace up for an unforgettable weekend at Stromlo Forest Park, Canberra, on November 14-15, 2026! The Stromlo Running Festival offers runners of all ages and abilities a chance to explore its trails. Participants can choose from six different courses: the Marathon, 30km, 15km, 10km, 5km, and the Indigenous Marathon Foundation 2.5K Kids Run.

Beyond the races, this event embodies a strong community spirit and resilience, a legacy rooted in the 2003 Canberra bushfires. Those running the Marathon, 30km, and 15km distances will receive an event tee, and all participants will have access to complimentary race-day photos. After crossing the finish line, a free Recovery Hub, staffed by University of Canberra physiotherapy students, will be available.

The courses are ITRA/UTMB indexed, reflecting the professional organization and the quality of the trail running experience offered at this purpose-built facility.

Get ready to immerse yourself in a world of stories and ideas as the Texas Book Festival lights up downtown Austin on November 14–15, 2026. This annual literary gathering is free and open to everyone, typically drawing over 45,000 book lovers who come to celebrate the written word.

Visitors will find a wide range of literary voices, with opportunities to hear from and meet more than 250 authors. The program covers various genres, from children's and young adult fiction to adult nonfiction. The festival also highlights Texas's literary heritage, recognizing David Bowles as the 2026 Texas Writer Awardee and featuring the artistry of Temi Coker, this year's Festival Poster Artist.

Beyond the weekend event, the festival's commitment to literacy continues throughout the year, supporting programs across the state.

Aspiring entrepreneurs and seasoned business owners alike are invited to explore a world of opportunity at The National Franchise Show Atlanta 2026. This event will be held on November 14-15, 2026, in Hall C of the Cobb Convention Center, serving as Atlanta's primary gathering for those interested in business ownership.

Presented by The Entrepreneur's Source, the show offers a direct way to connect with established businesses that are expanding across various industries and investment levels. Attendees can explore both full-time and part-time ownership possibilities. The program also includes complimentary seminars covering essential topics such as legal considerations, financing strategies, and how to select the right business for individual goals.

Public and land-grant university leaders are invited to the APLU Annual Meeting 2026, taking place November 15-17 in San Antonio, Texas. This gathering, centered around the theme *Our Enduring Mission*, will bring together over 1,500 presidents, chancellors, provosts, and senior administrators. The aim is to collectively examine higher education's essential role in advancing national progress.

Bestselling author David Brooks will speak, sharing his perspectives on the nation's condition 250 years after its founding and how universities contribute to addressing societal challenges. The agenda includes concurrent sessions and council meetings. Prepare to fortify your defenses against financial crime during International Fraud Awareness Week 2026, an annual global initiative spearheaded by the Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE). This is a dedicated time when organizations, their employees, and Certified Fraud Examiners worldwide come together to actively address the persistent challenge of fraud. Throughout the week, many mark the occasion by hosting local educational events, issuing public statements, and sharing important anti-fraud information across social media platforms.

This reality underscores the critical need for effective prevention strategies, strong ethical governance, and ongoing vigilance. Ultimately, the week encourages a collective effort to foster a culture of integrity within organizations, helping to protect assets from financial deception.

The Twelfth Family Wealth Report Family Office Investment Summit convenes on November 16, 2026, at PwC, 300 Madison Avenue, New York City. This full-day gathering, running from 8:30 am to 6:00 pm EST, is designed for senior investment professionals, principals, and advisors who work with single and multi-family offices, both within the US and internationally.

Discussions throughout the day will explore strategies for managing private wealth portfolios. Participants will engage in conversations covering asset allocation, risk management, private markets, governance, and long-term capital preservation. Expert panels and peer-led sessions will examine the challenges family offices face as economic conditions, regulations, and generational dynamics continue to evolve.

The agenda includes perspectives from leaders such as Jesse Friedlander, offering insights into global capital markets. Attendees can also learn about innovative approaches like asset tokenization and participate in structured networking opportunities for valuable peer exchange.

This gathering brings together regulators, operators, suppliers, and engineers from across America’s maritime LNG value chain.

The summit provides a forum for professionals to connect and collaborate on ideas that will influence the future of sustainable shipping.

Prepare for the future of taxation at the MNCPA Tax Conference 2026, held November 16-17 in Minneapolis, MN, and virtually online. This two-day gathering is for CPAs, accounting professionals, attorneys, and financial decision-makers who want to understand and navigate the changing tax landscape.

These Summits will cover areas such as Instructional Design, K12 education, and Affordable Learning Solutions tailored for Historically Black Colleges and Universities.

The program offers opportunities to explore new research, share effective practices, and foster collaborations that support learner success and human-centered digital education.

The future of legal innovation will converge at the TLTF Summit 2026, from November 16-18, 2026, at The Phoenician, A Luxury Collection Resort in Scottsdale, Arizona. This invite-only event focuses on bringing together key figures to connect, collaborate, and move the legal industry forward, influencing the legal technology landscape. Attendees typically include C-suite executives, law firm managing partners, general counsels, investors, and legaltech founders.

A significant part of the summit involves the Summit Sessions, where entrepreneurs present their legal innovations directly to investors and industry leaders. Participants can expect to gain new perspectives, build valuable connections, and play a part in the ongoing development of legal practices.

The event includes access to all programming, activities, and meals.

name: Transmission & Distribution Conference 2026
topics_keywords: Conf; Distribution; Mission; Transmission
description:
Join industry leaders and experts at the CEATI Transmission & Distribution Conference 2026, taking place in Denver, CO, from November 17-18. The discussions will center on technology innovations and strategic methods crucial for advancing electrification and working towards a carbon-free energy future.

Those attending can explore new solutions, participate in important conversations, and meet others who are shaping the future of energy infrastructure. It's a forum for sharing new research, and submissions for abstracts are currently being accepted. Participants can find opportunities to collaborate and gain knowledge that will influence the future of power delivery.

Information about sponsorship is also available.

From November 16–19, 2026, the Manchester Grand Hyatt in San Diego, California, will host Used Car Week, the definitive event for every major player in the used-car industry. This multi-day conference, organized by Cherokee Media Group, features five distinct tracks: Auto Fin, National Remarketing, Pre-Owned, Repo, and the National Auto Venture & Investors Conference (NAVIcon).

Attendees will examine important subjects such as artificial intelligence, financial technology advancements, regulatory changes, data analysis, and risk management approaches. It offers an opportunity to engage with leaders in the field, learn about new technologies, and gain insights into market trends and future perspectives. The gathering also acknowledges achievements through awards programs, including 'Women in Collections and Recoveries' and 'Women in Remarketing'.

For individuals whose work involves finance, remarketing, pre-owned sales, or investment, Used Car Week 2026 provides a setting for discussing strategies and fostering collaboration within the industry.

VentureTech 2026, the premier event connecting Credit Unions with innovative fintech solutions, returns to the Omni Fort Worth from November 16th – 18th. This gathering is for credit union executives, CUSOs, and industry leaders focused on the future of financial services.

Attendees will encounter over 25 fintech presentations, each carefully evaluated for relevance to the credit union industry, showcasing emerging technologies. The event also provides opportunities to connect with decision-makers, fostering discussions and potential collaborations.

This environment allows participants to explore new ideas and consider strategies for maintaining their institution's position in a rapidly evolving landscape.

name: Work Fleet Forum 2026
topics_keywords: Fleet; Forum; Work
description:
Top fleet leaders seeking cutting-edge solutions will converge at the Work Fleet Forum 2026, from November 16-18, at the luxurious Palms Resort in Las Vegas, NV. This peer-to-peer event, which also hosts the Food Fleet Council, is designed for managers of hard-working fleets to explore new products and technologies. Attendees can engage in candid conversations with colleagues and key vendors, finding solutions that help reduce costs, improve productivity, and enhance driver safety.

Attendance is capped at 50 fleets, creating a focused environment for networking and professional development. Qualified fleet purchasing decision-makers overseeing 100 or more trucks may be eligible to attend at no cost, with airfare and accommodation included.

Beyond the strategic sessions, evenings offer a chance for relaxed discussions over food and drink, continuing the peer exchange in an informal setting.

The U.S. Army Aviation Enterprise will converge at the Von Braun Center in Huntsville, AL, from November 17-19, 2026, for the AAAA Cribbins Readiness Conference. This two-and-a-half-day event marks the first time the entire Army Aviation Community has gathered comprehensively since the "Continuous Transformation" initiative began.

Trainers, operators, logisticians, and key decision-makers will have the opportunity to engage directly with the Army Aviation Branch Leadership (AVGOSC) during morning briefings. A key feature of the conference will be the afternoon "open mic" sessions, offering a direct channel for attendees to share their ideas and perspectives, with feedback going straight to the AVGOSC.

Beyond these discussions, participants can explore exhibitor displays, connect with colleagues, and arrange one-on-one briefings with PEO Aviation project managers and industry leaders. All activities at the conference are designed to support the ongoing efforts to strengthen readiness and advance future vertical-lift capabilities.

The meeting serves as a forum for state Department of Transportation executives, engineers, and policymakers. Here, they can collaborate on the significant issues that will shape America's transportation future. Those attending will explore new innovations, discuss important policy developments, and exchange successful approaches across all transportation modes.

It also provides a chance to connect with peers, build partnerships, and collectively address the ongoing challenges and opportunities in creating a safer, more resilient, and sustainable transportation network. This is an opportunity to engage with key figures in the field and contribute to shaping the next generation of transportation solutions nationwide.

description:
The rapid evolution of Artificial Intelligence is fundamentally reshaping intellectual property landscapes. On November 17, 2026, professionals will convene at AI & IP Europe 2026, an event hosted by World IP Review at the Brussels Marriott Hotel Grand Place. The day is designed to help participants understand and respond to these changes.

The agenda includes more than 20 presentations and interactive discussions. Participants will explore the implications of the EU AI Act, address questions of ownership for works created by AI, and consider approaches to maintaining a competitive edge. The program also covers regulatory frameworks for autonomous AI and an assessment of advanced AI tools that are changing IP practice, from patent searching to trademark monitoring.

This gathering is intended for in-house IP counsel, private practice attorneys, and AI service providers. It will feature contributions from experienced professionals, including Carola Lempke from AstraZeneca and Douglas Gordon from Leonardo UK. The aim is to help attendees understand legal frameworks, improve AI governance, and prepare their IP strategies for an AI-driven future.

Prepare to advance your expertise in electronic system design and verification at DVCon Europe 2026, taking place November 17-18 at the Holiday Inn in Munich, Germany. This event explores the practical application of languages, tools, and intellectual property for designing and verifying electronic systems and integrated circuits. It brings together chip architects, design and verification engineers, and IP integrators to examine current methodologies and EDA solutions.

The program includes keynote presentations from the Technical University of Munich and Axelera AI, addressing topics such as the 'AI Talent Gap' and 'Pragmatic Verification'. Participants will find a schedule of Engineering Full Papers, Research Papers, and Tutorials. There will also be opportunities for professional interaction and an exhibition area presenting new developments in the field.

description:
The European Automotive Intelligent Cockpit and Smart Driving Summit 2026, taking place on November 17-18 in Stuttgart, Germany, and via live broadcast, is set to be a landmark event for the automotive industry. This two-day summit will examine how smart cockpits and driving technology are evolving, particularly with the rise of the Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV) era.

The agenda includes a focus on key advancements. Participants will explore the application of large AI models in smart cockpits, next-generation E/E architectures, and innovative Human-Machine Interface (HMI) and User Experience (UX) design. Other topics will cover connected car technology, augmented reality HUDs, cloud connectivity, and the integration of Large Language Models into in-vehicle voice assistants.

This event is intended for C-level executives, VPs, and technical experts from OEMs, Tier 1/2 suppliers, and AI firms. It provides a forum for gaining valuable insights and connecting with peers to discuss and influence the direction of automotive intelligence.

On November 17, 2026, the IDC Qatar CIO Summit will convene at the Mondrian Doha, marking seven years as Qatar's premier gathering for technology decision-makers. Under the theme "The Rise of Agentic Systems," this one-day gathering will bring together CIOs and senior leaders from both government and private sectors to explore the evolving landscape of digital intelligence.

Discussions will cover key areas, including how to deploy AI responsibly and at scale, modernize existing systems, build stronger data foundations, and manage infrastructure expenses effectively. Additionally, the program will examine strategies for developing AI talent and ensuring AI initiatives deliver tangible results, reflecting Qatar's growing role as a center for digital innovation in the region.

Given that regional AI spending is expected to reach USD 25.9 billion by 2029, the insights shared at this summit will be valuable for technology leaders as they shape their strategies for the evolving agentic era.

Prepare to connect, innovate, and shape the future of LGBTQ+ tourism at the IGLTA Global Convention 2026. The event will be held in Seville, Spain, a city recognized for its progressive outlook and accessible environment, where new ideas often take root. This gathering brings together destination leaders, industry experts, suppliers, and buyers from around the world.

Participants will address the most pressing issues impacting LGBTQ+ communities and the travel sector. The agenda offers opportunities to share insights, discuss challenges, and explore strategies for navigating the evolving landscape of inclusive travel. These discussions aim to foster new perspectives and identify pathways for growth.

Meliá Hotels International will host attendees, providing a comfortable and inspiring setting for the convention. The aim is to facilitate meaningful interactions and the development of lasting professional relationships within the global LGBTQ+ tourism community.

The forefront of protein and antibody engineering will converge at PEGS Europe 2026, the continent's leading summit for biologics technology. This annual gathering, presented by Cambridge Innovation Institute, brings together biopharma professionals to engage with cutting-edge research and innovation.

The program delves into significant advancements, such as the integration of machine learning and AI in protein design, the development of multispecific antibodies and ADCs, and breakthroughs in immunoengineering and CAR therapy. The exhibition floor provides a space for networking, fostering collaboration, and exploring the latest tools that are shaping the future of protein science.

Dive into the future of aquatic innovation at Piscine Global 2026, the premier international event for the swimming pool and wellness industry. From November 17 to 20 at Eurexpo LYON, France, this gathering will present the latest trends and solutions across the pool, spa, and wellness markets, reflecting the sector's evolution and new approaches to water.

A significant part of the event is the return of Aqualie on November 19. This segment provides a specific focus for communities, public decision-makers, and professionals involved with collective aquatic facilities. Those attending, such as manufacturers, installers, architects, and local authorities, will have the opportunity to connect with key industry figures and explore new solutions.

Piscine Connect, a digital tool, is available to help visitors manage their time and connections effectively. In partnership with FPP, Piscine Global 2026 offers a forum for industry leaders to discuss and influence the direction of aquatic leisure and business.

This is a chance to engage with leaders in Silicon Valley and contribute to the direction of global industries.

description:
The Ibero-American Society of Digital Graphics (SIGraDi) proudly presents its 30th international congress, SiGraDi 2026, returning to the Universidad de Chile in Santiago from November 18-20. Hosted by the Facultad de Arquitectura y Urbanismo, this year's congress will explore the theme "Beyond AI_ded Design: Looking Forward, Looking Backward." It will consider how algorithmic structures, intelligent environments, and AI-mediated autonomous systems are influencing design, architecture, and urbanism.

Participants from academic, professional, and creative communities will explore topics such as generative design, digital fabrication, extended reality, and smart cities. Discussions will also address the critical environmental and ethical considerations inherent in computational architecture.

The congress will encourage conversations about new forms of cognition, agency, and distributed processes, considering how these shape project-based practices with a necessary focus on technological ethics.

Explore the critical intersection of major project development, Indigenous rights, and climate change at Cumulative Effects Assessment & Management Eastern Canada 2026. This symposium will take place from November 18-20, 2026, at the Novotel Toronto North York Hotel. It is intended for professionals who work with complex environmental assessments and regulatory frameworks.

The program includes two pre-conference workshops, focusing on Cumulative Effects 101 and the integration of Traditional Indigenous Knowledge. These workshops lead into a two-day conference where discussions will cover subjects such as responsibly accelerating major projects, Indigenous-led cumulative effects monitoring, and managing the impacts of transmission expansion. Sonja Kosuta and Jeff Rempel will serve as co-chairs, providing their perspectives throughout the event.

Attendees can earn CPD accreditation. This gathering brings together individuals from environmental, regulatory, and resource sectors, offering a space to collaborate and contribute to sustainable development across Eastern Canada.

Unlock the future of biopharmaceutical development at Protein Stability & Formulation 2026, presented by Cambridge Healthtech Institute. The main conference, held on Thursday, 19 November 2026, will explore important developments in biophysical stability, aggregation, and new formulation strategies. Participants also have the option to attend a dedicated short course on 'Developability of Bispecific Antibodies' on Monday, 16 November, for more specialized learning.

The program includes a keynote discussion about polysorbate degradation. Further sessions will cover topics such as using machine learning for stability prediction, advanced computational modeling, and innovative delivery systems, including oral and inhaled biologics.

This gathering provides an opportunity to engage with experts and learn about new approaches to address formulation challenges. The aim is to help advance the development of stable protein therapeutics.

Elevate your enterprise's defenses and strategic vision at the Vancouver Cybersecurity Summit 2026.

This in-person summit, taking place on Thursday, November 19, 2026, at the JW Marriott Parq Vancouver, is for active cybersecurity, IT, and information security practitioners. It brings together hundreds of pre-screened CISOs, senior leaders, and experts, offering a day of insights and opportunities for professional connection.

description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the vibrant world of contemporary art at World Art Dubai 2026, the MENA region's largest fair. From November 19-22, the Dubai World Trade Centre's Za’abeel Halls 2 & 3 will display more than 10,000 artworks. Visitors can explore pieces from over 400 exhibitors, a group that includes 275 solo artists and 120 galleries from more than 65 countries. Artworks will be available, with prices starting at $100.

Key features of the event include the Emerging Artist Prize, a dedicated Textile Hub, and PhotoWAD. Attendees will have opportunities to engage with featured artists such as wildlife photographer Minkie Du Toit and painter Farzin Allana. The event also presents a chance to explore spaces like Russia's Shrainer Gallery. World Art Dubai 2026 provides a significant occasion for art enthusiasts and collectors to connect with creative works from around the world.

description:
The ACTFL Annual Convention and World Languages Expo 2026 invites thousands of educators, administrators, and language leaders to San Antonio, TX, from November 19-22 at the Henry B. González Convention Center.

The gathering provides extensive opportunities for professional growth, featuring more than 600 educational sessions and an exhibit hall showcasing over 200 companies. Participants can explore new resources in specialized areas such as the AI Corner Classroom and the Digital Learning Lounge, both designed to support the success of multilingual learners.

The program includes presentations from keynote speakers Debbie Allen and Mychal-Bella Rayne Bowman. It also offers a chance to connect with a wide network of colleagues and find practical approaches to influence the direction of language education. The event aims to foster innovation and professional development for educators at all career stages.

name: AIBC Conference 2026
topics_keywords: Conf
description:
The 7th International Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Conference (AIBC Conference 2026) will convene from November 20-22, 2026, at Ritsumeikan University in Osaka, Japan. This gathering will bring together researchers and industry professionals from around the world. The aim is to explore the connection between artificial intelligence and blockchain technologies, understanding how they influence the creation of intelligent systems and efficient processes across various fields.

The conference program includes a range of technical sessions and presentations from keynote speakers. These sessions are designed to encourage discussions on recent advancements and address important open questions in the field. For authors, there is an opportunity to publish accepted papers in ACM Proceedings, which are indexed by Scopus and Ei Compendex.

Participants can expect to engage with a wide array of subjects. These include the design of intelligent system architectures and the specific applications of blockchain in areas like healthcare and travel. The conference provides a setting for those interested in contributing new research or gaining deeper insights into these evolving technologies.

Elevate your leadership and shape the future of education at the CABE/CAPSS Convention 2026, taking place November 20-21 at the Mystic Marriott Hotel & Spa in Groton. Europe's largest celebration of vintage design, the Brussels Design Market 2026, invites enthusiasts and collectors alike to Gare Maritime at Tour & Taxis on November 21-22. Within the 8,000 square meter Gare Maritime, 185 dealers from across Europe will present their collections.

Visitors will find a broad selection of 20th-century design, ranging from Scandinavian minimalism to Italian modernism and American classics. Pieces by legendary designers such as Le Corbusier, Jacobsen, and Bertoia will be available, alongside other distinctive items. With over 10,000 visitors expected, the market offers an occasion to explore significant design pieces. It's an event for both seasoned collectors and those simply looking for inspiration, providing a comprehensive look into design history.

Get ready for a festive journey with a 'mod, retro flair' at the 17th Annual Funky Finds Holiday Shopping Experience 2026! Visitors will find over 150 local makers and pickers showcasing handmade, vintage, and upcycled items, offering a wide selection of unique gifts for the holiday season.

description:
Set to redefine the trajectory of aviation sustainability across the Asia-Pacific, the Sustainable Aviation Futures APAC Congress 2026 convenes in Singapore from November 23-25. Over three days, under the theme 'Powering Partnerships to Scale SAF and eFuels in APAC,' the congress will bring together leaders, policymakers, and innovators from across the aviation and energy sectors.

Conversations will focus on key areas such as feedstock pathways, policy alignment, investment strategies, and infrastructure development. The aim is to advance the commercial use of Sustainable Aviation Fuel and eFuels.

To encourage collaboration and practical solutions, the event offers carefully planned sessions, a dedicated Networking Exhibition Zone, and AI-Matchmaking. These elements are designed to help participants build meaningful connections and long-term partnerships, which are crucial for a more sustainable aviation future.

name: Total Rewards Reloaded 2026
topics_keywords: Al; Rewards; Total Rewards
description:
Total Rewards Reloaded 2026 offers a pivotal opportunity to redefine compensation and benefits, inspiring people and advancing total rewards strategies. Over 660 leading rewards innovators and decision-makers from more than 360 companies across Europe will convene for two days, November 23-24, at Titanic Chaussee Berlin.

The agenda includes over 130 expert-led sessions, more than 70 industry case studies, and over 50 interactive workshops. The program explores the future of rewards, combining data-driven insights with human-centric design principles. Discussions will address critical topics such as AI in compensation, pay transparency, personalized benefits, and employee well-being.

Attendees will also have access to co-located events, including Talent Management Reloaded, Rethink! HR Tech, and HR Analytics & AI Europe, alongside dedicated one-on-one meetings. The event is designed to facilitate the evaluation of new services and technologies, a stated goal for 88% of past participants. It serves as a key gathering for those focused on strategic reinvention within total rewards.

name: Totally Concrete Dubai 2026
topics_keywords: Concrete
description:
Prepare to explore the cutting edge of concrete innovation at Totally Concrete Dubai 2026, held from 23 to 26 November at the Dubai World Trade Centre. This gathering brings together over 12,000 attendees and more than 240 exhibitors from over 20 countries, including contractors, developers, engineers, and manufacturers. It's a place for industry professionals to connect and share insights.

The event focuses on precast, cement, and structural materials, showcasing innovations and advanced concrete technologies designed to improve durability and performance. Attendees can explore sustainable solutions for concrete production and infrastructure projects, see product launches demonstrated live, and gain insights from experts during the Big 5 Talks. Leadership Summits will also host discussions on regional development strategies, providing a comprehensive view of the sector's future.

description:
Redefine your approach to private markets at AltPrivateWealth 2026, held on 24-25 November at the prestigious Hurlingham Club, London.

This two-day event focuses on "Unlocking & Scaling Private Markets for Private Wealth." It will explore strategies for building resilient portfolios, refining allocation, and achieving consistent performance in today's demanding investment landscape. The gathering brings together over 310 senior private wealth investors, general partners, and regulators. Discussions will cover critical themes such as advanced portfolio construction, liquidity solutions, evolving valuation methods, and how technology can support informed decision-making.

Over 60 expert speakers, including leaders from Rothschild & Co and J.P. Morgan, will contribute through interactive panels, peer-led debates, and Chatham House workshops. The format encourages direct problem-solving and fosters connections, aiming to help participants navigate private markets with greater precision and resilience.

name: Bauma China 2026

description:
Get ready to experience the future of construction and mining at Bauma China 2026, Asia's premier international trade fair. This year, the event will be held across two venues in Pudong, Shanghai: the Shanghai New International Expo Centre (SNIEC) and the Shanghai World Expo Exhibition & Convention Center (SWEECC). From November 23 to 27, 2026, more than 4,000 exhibitors from 30 countries are expected to participate.

The exhibition will cover 400,000 square meters, showcasing a comprehensive range of construction machinery, building material machines, mining machines, and construction vehicles. A significant focus will be placed on Next-Gen and Green Technologies. Attendees can also expect to see live demonstrations and engage in industry forums. This gathering offers a chance to observe new developments and connect with professionals from the global industry.

As Germany's largest PV business conference, it brings together innovative companies and key figures from across the entire solar value chain.

On October 1-2, 2026, Hanoi, Vietnam will become Southeast Asia's premier nexus for global VC investment and innovation as it hosts GITEX VIETNAM 2026. This event, supported by Government Alignment and GITEX GLOBAL, is anticipated to bring together over 250 institutional investors and 750 startups, alongside leaders from enterprises and the public sector.

Attendees will have the opportunity to explore the latest developments in AI, Cybersecurity, Data Centres, Fintech, and Quantum technologies. The program features specific events such as the Vietnam AI & Chips Summit, the AI 100 startup showcase, and the Supernova Pitch Competition, which includes a SGD 60K prize pool. Discussions with leading CISOs will take place in designated areas, and the Crystal Ball forum will offer various perspectives on future trends.

The gathering aims to foster connections and facilitate discussions that contribute to the evolution of Southeast Asia's digital landscape and support Vietnam's role in the global technology arena.

description:
The global movement towards sustainable built environments converges at the Green Building Congress 2026, set for November 26–28 at the Jio World Convention Centre in Mumbai, India. This three-day gathering is recognized as a leading event in Asia and globally, focused on Green and Net Zero Built Environments, aiming to advance net zero practices in buildings.

Attendees can explore solutions covering key areas: Net Zero Buildings, Materials & Circularity, Cooling & HVAC, Energy Efficiency, and Smart Buildings. The conference includes sessions led by experts, discussing policy and real-world case studies, alongside an expo presenting innovations in interiors, exteriors, and building technology.

It offers opportunities to connect with leaders, policymakers, and pioneers from the industry, and learn about future-focused strategies. Associated events, such as the IGBC Green Design Competition, also aim to inspire sustainable innovation. This makes it a significant gathering for those involved in the built environment sector.

Eurasia’s largest health technology gathering, HIMSS Eurasia 2026, will convene from November 26-28 at the Sueno Hotel in Belek – Antalya, Türkiye.

This three-day event serves as a significant forum for health system executives, clinical leaders, and innovators in digital health from around the globe. The program will open with remarks from Türkiye's Minister of Health and HIMSS President & CEO Hal Wolf. The agenda will focus on how digital technology can enhance patient care and streamline operations, exploring practical applications and future directions.

A dedicated track will explore the practical application of AI in healthcare, moving from theoretical concepts to real-world deployment. This includes discussions on national screening programs and AI's role in clinical decision support. Additionally, the Start-Up Arena provides a space for emerging companies to connect with potential collaborators and investors. The gathering is expected to bring together over 1,300 participants from 45 countries, all contributing to conversations about the future of global health innovation.

Europe's leading minds in software engineering and DevOps will converge at the Enterprise DevOps Summit 2026. This two-day gathering runs concurrently with the Enterprise Continuous Delivery & Automation, Software Testing & QA, and DevSecOps Summits, with access to all included in a single ticket.

The program offers over 68 hands-on case studies, more than 56 interactive workshops, and live product demonstrations. Participants can also arrange nearly 200 dedicated one-on-one meetings. Discussions will delve into significant areas such as AI-driven DevOps transformation, Platform Engineering, and secure agentic governance.

This summit is designed for over 500 decision-makers representing more than 280 companies. It provides a forum to address challenges related to accelerating delivery, optimizing costs, and embedding security across enterprise-grade cloud-native architectures.

The European Refining Technology Conference (ERTC) returns for its landmark 30th edition in Madrid, Spain, from November 30 to December 3, 2026. This four-day event brings together over 1,200 senior executives, technologists, and regulators, including more than 400 refiners, to address the central theme of "FUTURE-PROOFING REFINING'S ROLE IN THE ENERGY MIX."

Participants will hear from over 100 expert speakers, exploring practical solutions for decarbonisation, innovation, and digitalisation within the downstream refining and petrochemical sectors. The agenda also includes discussions on geopolitical shifts and policy changes, with an emphasis on fostering collaboration to help secure the industry's future.

The conference will also include the ERTC Awards, recognizing outstanding achievements and leadership within the sector. Senior figures from companies such as TotalEnergies, Shell, and ExxonMobil are expected to attend, contributing to conversations that will help define the future of energy.

description:
Addressing the unprecedented demands of AI-driven infrastructure, Advancing Data Center Construction 2026 convenes in Atlanta, GA, from December 1-3. This three-day event focuses on addressing significant challenges facing the Eastern U.S. data center industry, including utility strain, supply chain delays, and the scarcity of skilled labor.

Bringing together over 1,200 industry leaders, including hyperscalers, colocators, and contractors, participants can explore practical insights through more than 15 sessions and workshops, with 80% of these being interactive. The program features five dedicated tracks that cover the entire project lifecycle, from initial planning and procurement to MEP integration. Held concurrently with Advancing Data Center Retrofits, the event provides over 25 hours for connecting with peers. The discussions will center on developing high-performing, energy-efficient, and AI-ready facilities, helping to ensure projects are prepared for future demands.

Addressing Canada's surging demand for rental housing, Apartment Development & Affordable Housing 2026 is set to convene on December 1, 2026, at the Metro Toronto Convention Centre, South Building. This gathering will explore the anticipated "apartment boom," examining the entire development lifecycle from financial viability and initial projections to feasibility, design considerations, and long-term ownership strategies. Discussions will encompass critical areas such as private equity, joint ventures, and the strategic shift from condominium to rental development.

The event brings together over 250 senior-level professionals, including more than 100 building owners, developers, and investors. It provides an environment for significant networking, allowing attendees to engage with institutional developers, lenders, municipalities, and financiers. Opportunities for collaboration and partnership building are facilitated through dedicated sessions, as well as during breakfast and lunch. Insights will be shared through expert keynotes, real-world case studies, and timely market updates, featuring confirmed speakers such as Stefania Parnanzone, Steven Gross, and Adrian Rocca.

Europe's clean energy transition takes centre stage at the Argus Clean Ammonia Europe Conference 2026, hosted by the Port of Rotterdam from December 1-3. This three-day gathering in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, will bring together over 250 senior leaders, producers, traders, and end-users from more than 125 companies across over 30 countries.

Participants will explore the practical aspects of clean ammonia's commercial development and infrastructure. Discussions will address complex regulatory frameworks, including CBAM and RED III, and examine evolving trade dynamics. The program also delves into blue and green ammonia production methods, project economics, and the growing demand for ammonia across maritime, energy, and industrial sectors.

description:
The future of the global mining industry will converge at Resourcing Tomorrow 2026, held from December 1-3 at London's Business Design Centre. As the anchor event of London Mining Week, this forum brings together over 2,300 senior decision-makers from more than 85 countries, including ministers, mining CEOs, and leading investors.

Attendees will examine critical topics such as the geopolitics of essential minerals, the energy transition, and how to build resilient supply chains. The event will also explore innovations, artificial intelligence, and automation that are reshaping the sector. Participants can engage in exclusive government and leadership roundtables, and use the 'Resourcing Tomorrow Connect' platform for networking. There will also be opportunities to see new technology and mining project presentations.

This gathering provides a setting for strategic discussions and insights, supporting sustainable growth and innovation across the global mining value chain.

description:
On December 1-2, 2026, Reuters NEXT 2026 will gather an exclusive, invitation-only assembly of senior policymakers, global business leaders, and pioneering innovators in New York. The summit, broadcast globally, will explore the significant shifts shaping our collective future.

Participants, primarily C-level and VP executives representing a wide range of industries and countries, will engage with critical subjects such as geopolitics, global markets, the impact of AI, and sustainable development.

The program includes interviews on the World Stage, panel discussions focusing on Finance & Markets and Technology & AI, and smaller, focused roundtables. These sessions are designed to offer deep understanding, encourage new connections, and help shape approaches to the challenges ahead.

description:
SaaStr Europa 2026, also known as SaaStr AI London, is poised to be Europe's biggest AI + B2B event, taking place December 1-2, 2026, at the Park Plaza Westminster Bridge in London. This event brings together over 2,500 AI-focused founders, B2B executives, and more than 300 venture capitalists. A significant portion of attendees, 61%, hold C-level positions.

The program includes over 75 sessions and more than 20 practical workshops focusing on AI and go-to-market strategies. These will be led by over 100 individuals recognized as AI pioneers and successful European company builders. Participants can explore current strategies for integrating AI across various business functions, including sales, marketing, and customer success. The aim is to help attendees understand how to succeed in an AI-driven B2B environment, manage the shift towards AI, and acquire practical knowledge. Additionally, there will be a live recording of the 20VC podcast, alongside opportunities to connect with other professionals.

Navigating the complexities of global economic sanctions and export controls is paramount for today's compliance professionals. The New York Forum on Economic Sanctions 2026 will gather senior leaders in sanctions, legal, and financial crime from December 1-3 at the New York City Bar. Discussions will focus on enforcement priorities, policy developments, and the geopolitical risks that are shaping the landscape for 2027.

The program offers perspectives on managing regulatory divergence, combating illicit finance, and integrating AI into compliance programs. Key jurisdictions will be explored, alongside specific topics such as digital assets, including the GENIUS Act, and issues related to China, including the COINS Act. Pre-conference workshops are also part of the schedule.

Attendees will have opportunities to engage with government officials and industry experts, facilitating peer-to-peer discussions. Continuing Legal Education (CLE) credits will be available.

From 2-4 December 2026, the InterContinental Berlin, Germany, will host the 32nd annual OEB Conference, a global, cross-sector exhibition dedicated to digital learning.

The focus this year is 'Humanity in the Intelligent Age: Empathy, Responsibility, and the Duty of Care.' This theme brings together individuals from education, technology, and learning across six continents to examine how AI and automation are reshaping our world. Discussions will center on guiding the future of learning, ensuring technology remains a tool for human benefit, and prioritizing people in all advancements.

Participants will engage with new ideas and approaches that broaden what's possible in learning, improve educational experiences, and help navigate both the complexities and potential of our increasingly intelligent era.

Participants will have the opportunity to delve into recent developments in treatments, strategies for self-management, and monitoring technologies. This exploration happens through abstract presentations, specialized courses such as the Resident EEG and Epilepsy Surgery programs, and interactive workshops. The event provides a setting to connect with peers, build collaborations, and learn from leading experts in the field.

Additionally, specific programs are available for skill development, including the AES Fellows Program and in-person HOBSCOTCH Coach Training. The goal is to offer a comprehensive experience for everyone involved.

description:
The Alzheimer’s Disease & Cognitive Disorders Symposium 2026 invites healthcare professionals to a crucial in-person gathering from December 4–6 at the Hyatt Regency Grand Cypress in Orlando, Florida. This three-day event, co-chaired by Drs. Marwan N. Sabbagh, Marc E. Agronin, and W. Clay Jackson, focuses on improving Alzheimer's and dementia care by sharing the latest knowledge.

The symposium is for neurologists, psychiatrists, primary care providers, geriatricians, nurse practitioners, physician associates, and nurses. It offers an opportunity for these professionals to connect with peers and collaborate.

Building on the experience of previous virtual events, this symposium provides a space to discuss new developments and approaches in neurologic and cognitive disorders. Leading experts will share insights aimed at enhancing patient care and contributing to the advancement of this important field.

Prepare to dive into the vibrant world of Japanese animation and comics at Anime Frontier 2026, set to electrify the Fort Worth Convention Center from December 4-6.

Over three days, the event will offer a range of experiences, from exhibits and exclusive premieres to various special events. Attendees can expect appearances by prominent guests from the anime and manga communities. The program begins Friday at 1 PM and concludes Sunday at 4 PM, with panels scheduled to run late into Friday and Saturday evenings.

This gathering provides an opportunity to explore new series, connect with fellow enthusiasts, and celebrate beloved franchises.

description:
Set against the breathtaking backdrop of Falmouth Harbour and English Harbour, including the historic Nelson’s Dockyard, the Antigua Charter Yacht Show 2026 invites industry professionals from December 4 to 9.

This trade-only gathering provides a unique opportunity for brokers and central agents to engage deeply with the luxury yacht charter market. Professionals can tour a diverse fleet of motor and sailing yachts, meeting directly with captains and crew. This allows for discussions on Caribbean itineraries, onboard amenities, and insights into the latest refits and new builds.

Beyond the yacht tours, the event also includes the Chef’s Competition and Tablescaping Competitions. These elements offer another way to experience the level of service and design found on the yachts operating in the Caribbean.

The main conference runs from December 4-5, with pre-conference sessions scheduled for December 3. While the full agenda and keynote speakers will be announced later, attendees can anticipate exploring current innovations and evidence-based strategies in children and youth occupational therapy.

Exhibition and sponsorship opportunities are available for those looking to connect with this community.

Between 8:00 AM and 6:00 PM, professionals in cloud and datacenter fields can expect to gain insights from a Plenary Session and various expert-led discussions.

The convention provides an opportunity to connect with peers, explore innovative solutions, and understand emerging trends that are shaping New Zealand's digital landscape. name: SACSCOC Annual Meeting 2026
topics_keywords: Al; Annual; Annual Meeting; Meet; Meeting
description:
Higher education leaders and accreditation professionals are invited to the SACSCOC Annual Meeting 2026, set for December 5-8 in Houston, Texas. The meeting's theme, "Exploring New Frontiers in Accreditation," will guide discussions on the evolving landscape of higher education. Participants will examine shifts in educational models, the impact of emerging technologies, and changing expectations from students and the workforce.

The program features a range of sessions, including plenary talks, concurrent discussions, and poster presentations. These will be led by colleagues from various institutions and Commission staff. A significant part of the meeting is President's Day, which will cover federal policy updates, and the College Delegate Assembly Business Meeting, where votes will be cast on the *Principles of Accreditation*. Additionally, specialized workshops, such as Evaluator Training and Leadership Orientation, are available for focused professional growth.

This in-person gathering offers a chance to connect with peers and share insights. It provides a forum for strengthening accreditation approaches across institutions through shared learning and collaboration.

The Karachi Expo Centre will host the highly anticipated Textile Asia Karachi 2026 from December 5th to 7th. This three-day event serves as a platform for advancing Pakistan's textile industry, aiming to improve quality and productivity across the sector. Those attending will see the newest developments in textile and garment machinery, along with a wide range of clothing accessories, raw materials, and dyes.

The exhibition offers a chance for local and international industrialists, investors, and decision-makers to discover new ideas and technologies. Companies showcasing their products can connect directly with a varied audience, increasing their reach. For all participants, it's an environment where industry connections are made, and discussions around potential business opportunities take place.

Shaping the future of California's housing landscape, the California Housing & Community Development Conference & Expo 2026 will convene over 800 industry experts and professionals at the JW Marriott L.A. Live in Los Angeles from December 7-8. This two-day gathering will explore new approaches to housing policy, finance, and delivery, all aimed at increasing the availability of affordable and workforce housing throughout California.

Content is tailored to address diverse needs, covering everything from initial brainstorming to developing concrete solutions. Participants will examine effective strategies spanning emotional, physical, and financial well-being. The event offers an opportunity to connect with peers, share insights, and explore interventions that can help cultivate a productive and thriving workforce.

The collective focus remains on reducing fraud and enhancing customer confidence.

Step into the future of fenestration at the 22nd International ZAK Doors & Windows Expo 2026, scheduled for 10–12 December at Yashobhoomi (IICC) in New Delhi, India. Attendees will find a comprehensive display of machinery, systems, profiles, and cladding solutions, alongside a variety of related products.

With over 200 brands exhibiting from 25 countries, the expo provides a setting to explore new materials, understand the latest technologies, and connect with others in the field. It offers a chance to see what's emerging in the sector and to engage directly with manufacturers and innovators.

An expo floor will also provide opportunities to interact with new wearable technology and biohacking tools. This environment fosters connections among leading figures in the field, encourages interactive learning, and highlights innovations that are influencing the future of health.

Attendees can expect engaging sessions that delve into current industry thinking, alongside exhibits displaying the latest advancements. The summit also offers significant opportunities for networking, serving as an important precursor to the main iDAC Expo in Mumbai. Attendees will have the chance to examine new research findings, share insights, and build connections across various disciplines.

description:
MACHMA Expo 2026, India's leading exhibition on Machine Tools, Automation & Laser Technology, celebrates its 13th edition from December 11-14 at Parade Ground, Chandigarh. This four-day event, spanning over 25,000 sq. ft., offers professionals a complimentary pass to explore the latest innovations. Visitors can expect to see more than 10,000 new products demonstrated live and connect with over 650 prominent exhibitors.

The expo brings together over 50,000 professionals, including engineers, manufacturers, and decision-makers, representing more than 27 industry sectors and 13 countries. It's a place to build connections and gain perspective. Expert-led conferences and workshops will offer discussions on the future of industries like automotive, aerospace, electronics, and manufacturing, highlighting key business developments and technological progress.

description:
On Friday, December 11, 2026, the Massachusetts Association of Health Plans Annual Health Care Conference will convene over 450 leading professionals for a critical exploration of "Health Care Affordability: From Challenge to Action." This sold-out conference brings together professionals to discuss critical topics influencing healthcare in Massachusetts and nationwide, fostering dialogue on pressing issues shaping the health care landscape.

Attendees will engage in discussions covering public health, system performance, crisis management, and evidence-driven policy. A key part of the program is the keynote address from Dr. Ashish K. Jha, a prominent figure in Public Health and former White House COVID-19 Response Coordinator. Dr. Jha will share his perspective on preparing for pandemics, developing robust bio-intelligence systems, and improving both the quality and affordability of care.

The MedSpa Pro Meeting 2026 stands as the ultimate destination for medical aesthetics professionals seeking unparalleled education, vital connections, and significant growth. This gathering offers both new and experienced practitioners an opportunity to engage with the latest developments in the medspa field, helping them adapt and succeed.

Attendees will hear directly from respected figures in the industry, including Dr. Jason Pozner, Dr. Barry DiBernardo, and Dr. Joseph Russo. The program delves into a wide array of subjects, from skincare and injectables to laser technologies and regenerative medicine. Discussions will also cover advanced approaches to aesthetic management, such as considerations for GLP-1 patients and those with estrogen-deficient skin.

The insights shared aim to provide practitioners with the understanding and abilities needed to maintain their edge, broaden their professional connections, and advance their careers within medical aesthetics.

name: Electrify Expo San Diego 2026
topics_keywords: Electrify; Expo
description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the electrifying future of mobility at Electrify Expo San Diego 2026! This large outdoor event provides a chance to ride, drive, and experience the newest electric vehicles, e-motorcycles, and e-bikes, among other innovations, spread across more than a million square feet.

Attendees will find a range of experiences, from the new Robotics Showcase and the Aerial Mobility zone, offering a look at future commuting, to the EV Terrain Park for off-road exploration. There will also be an opportunity to test self-driving technology in the Hands Free Zone. Beyond the technology, the event will include music, food, and activities suitable for families.

While specific dates and the San Diego venue for 2026 are still being finalized, the event aims to offer a comprehensive, hands-on exploration into the world of electrification. Further details will be shared as they become available.

The future of personalized healthcare and intelligent medical solutions will converge at the IEEE-EMBS International Conference on Biomedical and Health Informatics (BHI’26). The conference, organized by IEEE EMBS, will take place from December 12th to 15th, 2026, in Hong Kong, China, offering a platform for groundbreaking research.

The conference explores how artificial intelligence, machine learning, and advanced informatics are used to transform complex biomedical data into actionable, individualized insights. Discussions will cover innovations in areas such as precision healthcare, digital twins, generative AI, and pervasive health monitoring. Participants, ranging from established researchers to students, will have opportunities to engage with these cutting-edge developments.

The program also includes a student data competition and visits to medical device companies in the Great-Bay Area. Recognition for outstanding contributions will be given through best paper awards. The gathering aims to foster discussions that will help shape the next generation of health informatics.

This meeting, organized by IEEE and the IEEE Electron Devices Society (EDS), brings together the community to discuss the future of electron devices. It is a key gathering where new ideas and directions in the field are explored.

Participants can expect to engage with significant developments in semiconductor technology, quantum computing, AI hardware, and emerging device physics. The event provides a setting for researchers, engineers, and industry leaders from around the globe to present their latest work, exchange knowledge, and build connections. These interactions are crucial for advancing microelectronics and understanding the evolving role of electronic devices in our world.

description:
Global Government Forum presents AccelerateGOV 2026, the essential international summit for public sector digital transformation. The Government of Canada is co-hosting this two-day event, taking place on December 16 and 17, 2026, in Ottawa. It offers public servants from around the world an opportunity to explore strategies for delivering more effective digital services.

Attendees will engage in panel discussions and Q&A sessions covering vital areas. These include practical applications of AI, advanced data technologies, strengthening cybersecurity, and improving procurement processes. The agenda also addresses user-centered design principles to encourage public adoption of new services, effective models for hybrid work, and developing skills that foster innovation.

This summit is designed for leaders and specialists from all government sectors. It aims to provide practical understanding and approaches that can help them manage the complexities of a rapidly evolving world and advance digital initiatives.

This design also creates opportunities for meaningful networking and discovering new developments within the exhibit hall, all within the beautiful setting of Maui.

The J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference 2027, taking place from January 11-14 in San Francisco, California, is poised to be the industry's most influential healthcare investment symposium.

This invitation-only event brings together global industry leaders, fast-growing companies, innovators in technology, and the investment community. Over four days, participants will discuss key market trends, financing activities, and the future direction of healthcare. The agenda covers biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, and medical devices, alongside how AI is influencing drug discovery and operational efficiency.

Those attending will explore topics such as dealmaking, M&A strategies, capital markets, and global innovation. The conversations aim to contribute to shaping the sector's future.
