Prepare to explore the frontiers of the global space economy at SpaceCom 2027, taking place from January 11-14 in Orlando, FL. This event focuses on the commercial space industry, with its theme "Powering the Next Space Age." It functions as a central point for sharing insights and fostering business connections.

Leaders from civil space, defense, and commercial sectors, representing over 30 countries, will come together. The aim is to foster progress by highlighting new technologies, sharing market intelligence, and encouraging collaborations between government and industry. Those attending, including agency delegations, global investors, and entrepreneurs, can participate in more than 70 sessions, attend federal briefings, and observe startup pitch competitions.

Discussions will cover developments in areas such as launch capabilities, operations in space, sustainability efforts, and human performance beyond Earth. This environment encourages new business connections and partnerships, with contributions from experts such as Bill Nye and Kathy Lueders. It serves as a significant forum for discussions that influence the future direction of space exploration and commerce.

description:
Celebrating six decades of dedication to kidney care, the FSN Annual Meeting 2027 invites you to "The Rhythm of Progress: 60 Years of Nephrology." This gathering will take place from January 15-17, 2027, at the JW Marriott Tampa Water Street in Tampa, Florida. It brings together nephrologists, fellows, residents, researchers, and nurses.

Attendees will hear from leading national and international experts, reflecting on the field's history while looking ahead to future patient care strategies. The program includes discussions on the business aspects of nephrology, a networking opportunity for Women in Nephrology Florida, and the 19th Annual Robert Geronemus Memorial Renal Research Competition. Continuing Medical Education (CME) and Maintenance of Certification (MOC) credits will be available, offering insights into the newest developments in kidney disease prevention and treatment.

This meeting provides a setting for colleagues from Florida and beyond to connect and contribute to the ongoing evolution of nephrology.

This week offers opportunities for learning, exploring new developments, and building professional relationships.

The event features over 500 exhibitors displaying the newest turf equipment, irrigation systems, and agronomic technology within a 178,600 square foot space. Educational seminars will cover practical topics such as robotics, AI applications, and advanced business strategies, led by researchers and experienced peers. From January 15 to 24, 2027, Berlin opens its doors to Green Week, an international exhibition dedicated to the future of agriculture, food, and horticulture. The exhibition explores various 'Theme Worlds,' ranging from displays of flowers to initiatives focused on sustainable living.

Visitors can explore the 'Event Farm,' taste foods from around the world, and see the equestrian shows at Hippologica. The program also features congresses, presentations on the Grüne Woche Stage, and specific days dedicated to startups, where new ideas are presented.

Workshops are designed for younger attendees, and the Regional-Star Award will recognize sustainable regional concepts. Green Week 2027 serves as a meeting point for those interested in rural life and its evolving landscape.

KeNIC will co-host the summit, alongside partners such as .Africa, ZARC (.za), RICTA (.rw), and Team Internet. The gathering is intended for professionals across the domain industry, including domain name registries, registrars, hosting companies, security experts, lawyers, and investors.

description:
Elevate your business acumen and master financial decision-making at the Finance for Decision Making (for Non-Finance Managers) Batch-25 program. This five-day, in-person course takes place at IIM Bangalore from January 18-22, 2027. It is designed for professionals from various fields—such as marketing, human resources, operations, and engineering—who wish to enhance their financial understanding, regardless of their prior finance experience.

Professor Padmini Srinivasan leads the program, which explores topics like interpreting financial statements, managing working capital, capital budgeting, and controlling costs. Participants will develop practical abilities to analyze financial information, apply important metrics to their daily work, and understand how their strategic decisions affect an organization's profitability and overall value.

The early bird registration deadline is December 28, 2026. Completing the program earns participants an IIMB certificate.

description:
Get ready for an unparalleled automotive experience at the Washington, DC Auto Show 2027, running from January 22 to 31 at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center.

As the region's largest indoor gathering of its kind and recognized as one of the nation's leading auto shows, it offers a comprehensive look at the future of personal transportation. Car enthusiasts, families, and media professionals will find an extensive display of what's new and what's next in the automotive world. Visitors will have the opportunity to explore the newest models from major manufacturers and engage with significant advancements in automotive technology.

The show highlights a broad spectrum of mobility solutions, ranging from robust vehicles designed for outdoor adventures to environmentally conscious innovations developed for various daily needs. Experiences available include dynamic indoor and outdoor test drives, interactive exhibits for consumers, and detailed presentations from different brands and within specialized pavilions. This gathering provides a comprehensive overview of current and future developments in transportation.

The Broward County Optometric Association invites optometrists and eye care professionals to the Gold Coast Educational Retreat 2027, taking place January 23-24 at the Omni Fort Lauderdale. Over two days, participants can earn 16 hours of continuing education credits. The program addresses key areas such as TQ, Medical Errors, Florida Jurisprudence, HIV & AIDS, and Practice Management.

Speakers, including recognized experts and national leaders in the field, will share their perspectives on current clinical strategies, managing ocular diseases, and surgical co-management. Beyond the educational sessions, the retreat provides a comfortable setting for connecting with peers. There will be opportunities to network and share experiences, complemented by the venue's amenities and provided meals. The environment encourages professional development and fosters connections among colleagues.

Mark your calendars for MEAD 2027, Arizona's premier mathematics education event, returning on January 23, 2027. This hybrid conference is designed to help teachers develop more inclusive classroom environments and refine their teaching methods.

Participants can attend either in person at Tucson High Magnet School and the UArizona Grand Ballroom, or remotely through Zoom. The day's schedule includes three blocks of sessions from 8 AM to 12 PM, concluding with a live-streamed Keynote Luncheon. Intended for thousands of mathematics educators, MEAD 2027 offers a space for professional discussions and connections with peers. A professional development certificate will be provided to all attendees, acknowledging their participation in furthering mathematics education.

The meeting will take place from January 23-25, 2027, at the Omni Amelia Island Resort & Spa in Fernandina Beach, FL. This event is designed to unite both established practitioners and those early in their careers.

Participants can expect a program of educational sessions focusing on the latest research, trends, and advancements in women’s health. In addition to these learning opportunities, the meeting provides a setting for colleagues to connect and strengthen professional skills. An exhibit hall will showcase innovations from various women’s health organizations. Social gatherings, such as the Presidential Luncheon and the SAAOG 2027 Gala, are also planned.

Participants will work to align key priorities and programs, and address the practical challenges in modernization, production, and the industrial base.

Redefine your pharmaceutical marketing approach at the Digital Pharma Advances Conference 2027, hosted by Global Insight Conferences in London. The event begins on January 26th with a Half-Day AI Workshop, designed to explore practical, compliant strategies for integrating AI into pharmaceutical operations. The following day, January 27th, the main conference will focus on developing AI-driven, customer-focused, and healthcare professional (HCP) engagement strategies across various channels.

Professionals in digital pharma marketing will find discussions centered on effectively integrating AI, developing meaningful customer journeys, and streamlining engagement with healthcare professionals. A key emphasis throughout the conference is maintaining regulatory compliance in all these areas.

The conference also provides opportunities for peer-to-peer networking, including a reception after the workshop. Attendees can connect directly with senior professionals from leading European pharmaceutical companies, fostering valuable discussions and connections.

description:
Scheduled for January 27-28, 2027, at Helsingin Messukeskus, Doctors' Days 2027 is Finland's foremost continuing medical education and professional healthcare event.

This two-day event, organized by the Finnish Medical Association and Messukeskus, brings together doctors, 5th and 6th-year medical students, and invited guests. Participants will explore the latest medical advancements through a series of training sessions and an extensive exhibition.

The gathering supports professional development, facilitates networking, and offers insights into key innovations in medicine. Building on the success of previous years, which consistently drew over 3500 medical professionals, Doctors' Days is designed for those seeking to enhance their medical knowledge and connect with colleagues and leaders in the field.

name: e-Health+MVTe 2027
topics_keywords: E-Health
description:
Scandinavia's leading decision-makers in health and social welfare are invited to e-Health+MVTe 2027, taking place in Stockholm on January 27-28.

This gathering addresses the digital evolution of healthcare, covering everything from administrative processes to advanced clinical treatments. The goal is to improve patient outcomes, elevate service quality, and manage costs more effectively.

Attendees, numbering over 4600 visitors and 2600 delegates, will have the opportunity to engage with more than 250 exhibitors. These exhibitors will present the latest in e-Healthcare and e-Welfare solutions, with a particular emphasis on advancements in Artificial Intelligence. The program includes insightful keynotes, interactive open stages, and structured networking sessions, such as the Speed Meeting Program. Participants can learn about Sweden's pioneering efforts in e-Health and gather valuable perspectives for understanding the SEK 430 billion Swedish healthcare market. A single ticket provides entry to three concurrent events.

name: Education Korea 2027
topics_keywords: Educatio; Education
description:
Prepare for the future of learning at Education Korea 2027, Asia's premier specialized fair for Education and EdTech. This event, held from January 27th to 29th, 2027, at COEX in Seoul, will explore the ongoing evolution of education in the 4th Industrial Revolution era.

The fair offers a look at new approaches, smart school innovations, and ways to create safe learning environments. These topics are covered across dedicated areas such as EdTech Korea, Early Education, and Next Education, which includes lifelong and vocational learning. Attendees can participate in international conferences at EDUCON, see new solutions at the ORANGE LABEL showcase, and use the EDU-AGORA biz-matching service to connect with others in the field.

Specialized seminars are planned for innovators, teachers, parents, students, and other professionals. This gathering brings together individuals who are actively shaping the next generation of education.

description:
Set against the vibrant backdrop of San Antonio, Texas, the AACS Annual Scientific Meeting 2027 will gather leading physicians and supporting staff in cosmetic surgery and aesthetic medicine from January 28-30. The meeting will take place at the San Antonio Marriott River Center on the River Walk. This gathering is designed to advance the field by bringing together professionals to share knowledge and explore new directions.

Those attending can expect a program that includes scientific presentations, discussions on innovative techniques, and conversations about the future of aesthetic care. It offers a chance for professional development, providing perspectives from experts and encouraging collaboration among colleagues.

The call for abstracts for the 2027 meeting will open in May/June 2026. This period will allow for the submission of research, contributing to a comprehensive exchange of new findings.

name: CE's on the Seas 2027
topics_keywords: He; Sea
description:
Combine essential professional growth with a tropical escape at CE's on the Seas 2027, presented by the Professional Opticians of Florida (POF). From January 28 to February 1, 2027, opticians and optical professionals have the opportunity to earn all 20 required continuing education hours. This experience takes place aboard the Carnival Paradise, departing from Port Tampa, FL, and sailing to Cozumel, Mexico.

Attendees will hear from leading national speakers during sessions designed to meet license renewal requirements. These learning opportunities are balanced with the amenities of the cruise and a full day dedicated to exploring Cozumel. Through POF's partnerships, members of participating state associations can enroll in approved courses, with a portion of their fees contributing to their home associations.

Cabins begin at $399 per person, based on double occupancy. This price includes taxes, port fees, meals, and onboard entertainment. To be part of the group block, reservations should be made by September 27, 2026.

Held at the Omni Nashville Hotel, this three-day gathering is dedicated to helping practices "Create a Culture of Success™" in both professional and personal life.

description:
The future of private markets wealth distribution will converge at IPEM Wealth Cannes 2027, taking place from February 2-4 at the prestigious Palais des Festivals in Cannes, France. This three-day event, titled "The Accelerator of Private Markets’ Wealth Revolution," will focus on the significant movement of private capital towards individual investors, channeled through wealth managers, family offices, and private banks.

The gathering expects approximately 3,800 participants, among them 550 LP delegates and 500 GP firms. Sessions, led by practitioners, are designed to cultivate commercial opportunities and develop solutions across all asset classes. Individuals attending will have opportunities to connect with industry leaders, examine innovative distribution strategies, and acknowledge achievements during the IPEM Wealth Awards.

The program includes high-level conferences, dedicated networking events, and the distinctive IPEM Express. These elements collectively aim to contribute to the ongoing evolution of the private markets wealth community, set against the backdrop of the French Riviera.

description:
Prepare to witness the future of transportation at the Bharat Mobility Global Expo 2027, taking place from February 4th to 9th at Bharat Mandapam and February 4th to 7th at Yashobhoomi in New Delhi. This event will present India's approach to a cleaner, smarter, software-driven, and interconnected mobility system, designed to integrate both urban and rural environments.

The expo addresses the entire mobility value chain, covering automotive and components, energy solutions, AI-driven technology, logistics, and advanced infrastructure. It brings together several focused exhibitions, allowing attendees to explore the latest developments. These include the Auto Expo Motor Show, alongside displays of battery and tyre technologies, air mobility advancements, construction equipment, and urban mass transit solutions.

The event anticipates over 1 lakh visitors, including original equipment manufacturers, global suppliers, startups, and investors. It provides a significant forum for business-to-business and business-to-government discussions, technology demonstrations, and expert sessions that contribute to shaping the next generation of mobility.

name: CISO Forum Canada 2027
topics_keywords: CISO; Canada; Forum
description:
On February 4, 2027, CISO Forum Canada 2027 convenes at The Ritz-Carlton, Toronto, bringing together Canada's most senior information security leaders.

This in-person event is designed for director-level and above executives. It focuses on strategic management, innovation, and practical approaches to complex cyber challenges.

The day's discussions will cover important subjects like navigating geopolitical cyber skirmishes, balancing human and AI judgment during a crisis, and effectively communicating cyber risk to boards. Participants will also explore securing AI agents and data pipelines, transforming security culture, and developing strong cyber resilience strategies. Through a full day of sessions led by experts, private roundtables, and an executive reception, attendees can expect to gain valuable perspectives and connect with their peers in Canadian cybersecurity leadership.

name: Cloud Tech Tallinn 2027
topics_keywords: Cloud; Cloud Tech; Tech
description:
Tallinn Creative Hub will host Cloud Tech Tallinn 2027 on February 4th and 5th, 2027, inviting professionals to explore the transformative power of Microsoft Cloud. Over two days, the event will focus on how advanced data analytics, AI, machine learning, and scalable cloud-native tools can benefit businesses and individual careers. Participants can expect sessions that delve into Microsoft Cloud SaaS products, AI services, collaboration tools, and application development.

Beyond learning from experts, the event also provides a setting for professionals to connect, share ideas, and explore potential collaborations with peers. Each day will conclude with social gatherings, offering a chance to experience Tallinn's unique charm.

The event aims to bring together learning, new ideas, and community for anyone interested in the Microsoft Cloud ecosystem.

description:

This two-day summit brings together over 500 senior InfoSec decision-makers from New South Wales, alongside more than 50 expert speakers. Leaders in cybersecurity, including CISOs, CTOs, and CIOs, will explore key topics. Discussions will cover how to integrate security into leadership strategies, manage the evolving threats posed by AI, and strengthen defenses against supply chain weaknesses.

The main summit is complemented by co-located events focusing on OT Security, Cloud Security, and AppSec & DevSecOps. Participants have the opportunity to earn CPE points through a partnership with ISACA Sydney.

name: World Ag Expo 2027
topics_keywords: Expo; World
description:
From February 9-11, 2027, the International Agri-Center® in Tulare, California, will transform into the epicenter of agricultural innovation for the World Ag Expo. This annual gathering is recognized as the largest of its kind, bringing together around 100,000 people from more than 70 countries. It offers a significant opportunity for individuals to connect, learn, and build professional relationships within the agricultural community.

Across 2.6 million square feet of exhibit space, more than 1,200 exhibitors will present the newest advancements in technology and equipment that are influencing how we farm. It's a place where new solutions are introduced, where industry leaders share their perspectives, and where the progress driving global agriculture can be observed firsthand.
